HomeHero.afternoonTitle: Motšeare o Motle! Linako tsa Bibele bakeng sa Letsatsi la Hao.

HomeHero.eveningTitle: Mantsiboea a Matle! Phomola ka Linako tsa Bibele.

Mission.eyebrow: E hahetsoe thomo ea lefatše lohle
Mission.headline: Molaetsa ha o fetohe. Tsela eo batho ba shebellang ka eona ke eona e fetohang.
Mission.intro: Re haha bocha laeborari ea rona ea livideo le lisebelisoa ho tloha motheong, re isa mosebetsi oa lilemo tse mashome oa phetolelo lipolatefomong tseo batho ba seng ba bokana, ba shebella le ho arolelana ho tsona.
Mission.libraryPointTitle: Laeborari ea lifilimi e fetoletsoeng ka ho fetisisa lefatšeng
Mission.libraryPointDescription: Mosebetsi oa lilemo tse mashome oa phetolelo, o etsoang ke balekane ba tšepahalang ba bosebeletsi, o hahile laeborari e nang le lipina tsa lipuo tse likete, e le hore batho ba ka kopana le pale ea Jesu ka puo e ba amang ka ho teba ka ho fetisisa.
Mission.formatsPointTitle: Ho isa mantsoe a tšepahalang mefuteng e mecha
Mission.formatsPointDescription: Re haha bocha tsela eo lipale tsa evangeli li phetoang ka eona ka litšoantšo, re kopanya liphetolelo tse tšepahalang le mefuta ea sejoale-joale, e le hore molaetsa o ka tsamaea ka bolokolohi lipolatefomong, litsong le lisekrineng tsohle.
Mission.teamPointTitle: Ho feta laeborari. Ke sehlopha se tsamaisoang ke thomo.
Mission.teamPointDescription: Jesus Film Project ke sehlopha sa lefatše lohle sa bafetoleli, litsebi tsa mecha ea litaba, bahlophisi le baqapi ba fetolang phihlelo ea lilemo tse mashome ea bosebeletsi hore e be lisebelisoa bakeng sa ba etsang barutuoa hohle.
Mission.highlightsHeading: Seo re tlang ho se haha
Mission.nextStepsDescription: E hokahanya bashebelli le menyetla ea sebele leetong la bona la moea, e ba thusa ho nka mohato o latelang ho kena sechabeng, Mangolong kapa thomong.
Mission.mediaLibraryTitle: Laeborari ea Mecha ea Litaba ea Boevangeli
Mission.mediaLibraryDescription: Laeborari e pharaletseng ea mecha ea litaba ea Bokreste e nang le livideo, lifilimi le lisebelisoa tse likete, tse fumanehang ka lipuo tse ngata bakeng sa bosebeletsi le boevangeli lefatšeng ka bophara.
Mission.ministryToolsTitle: Lisebelisoa tsa Dijithale bakeng sa Bosebeletsi
Mission.ministryToolsDescription: Tsamaiso ea livideo, kabo ea litaba, ho kopanela le bamameli le litlhahlobo, tse etselitsoeng ho thusa bosebeletsi ho fihlela batho ba bangata ka katleho.
Mission.inviteHeadline: Thusa ho haha {accent} oa lisebelisoa tsa thomo
Mission.inviteBody: Re mema litsebi, baqapi le balekane ho sebelisa lisebelisoa pele ho ba bang. Leka lisebelisoa tse ncha pele, fana ka maikutlo, ’me u thuse ho bopa lihlahisoa tse etselitsoeng mosebetsi oa sebele oa thomo.
Mission.missionCardAriaHint: E bula leqephe la thomo ea Jesus Film
Mission.roadmapCardAriaHint: E bula leqephe la thomo ea Jesus Film karolong ea moralo
Mission.betaCardAriaHint: E bula ngoliso ea beta sebatling sa hao
